_readme: Shopify Plus target knowledge. SEED, not stable: the two lists below were derived from general platform knowledge and must be re-checked against the API version (YYYY-MM) a project actually pins - GraphQL fields, connections and Function targets change per version. Stable part: the split between Storefront API (customer-facing), Admin API (back office), Customer Account API and Functions/extension targets.
target_api_endpoint_families: Storefront GraphQL query: products / product(handle) / productByIdentifier (catalog read)
Storefront GraphQL query: collections / collection(handle).products (category listing, filters)
Storefront GraphQL query: search / predictiveSearch (search and suggest)
Storefront GraphQL mutation: cartCreate / cartLinesAdd / cartLinesUpdate / cartLinesRemove
Storefront GraphQL mutation: cartBuyerIdentityUpdate / cartAttributesUpdate / cartDiscountCodesUpdate / cartNoteUpdate
Storefront GraphQL field: cart.checkoutUrl (hand-off into Shopify-hosted checkout)
Storefront GraphQL query: customer + customerAccessTokenCreate / customerCreate / customerRecover (classic customer accounts)
Storefront GraphQL query: metaobjects / metaobject (structured content)
Storefront GraphQL query: menu (navigation / linklist)
Storefront GraphQL directive: @inContext(country, language, buyerIdentity) for Markets pricing and localisation
Storefront GraphQL query: pages / blog / article / shop.shopPolicies (editorial and legal content)
Customer Account API (GraphQL): customer, orders, addresses, companyLocations, draftOrders (new customer accounts)
Admin GraphQL: Product / ProductVariant / productSet / productOptions (catalog write)
Admin GraphQL: InventoryItem / InventoryLevel / inventorySetQuantities (stock)
Admin GraphQL: Order / order edits / draftOrderCreate / draftOrderComplete (sales-rep assisted ordering)
Admin GraphQL: Customer / Company / CompanyLocation / CompanyContact (B2B on Shopify)
Admin GraphQL: PriceList / Catalog / publication (B2B catalogs, customer-specific pricing)
Admin GraphQL: metafieldDefinitionCreate / metafieldsSet / metaobjectDefinitionCreate (structured data)
Admin GraphQL: FulfillmentOrder / fulfillmentCreate / ReturnRequest (fulfilment and returns)
Admin GraphQL: discountAutomaticAppCreate / discountCodeAppCreate (Function-backed discounts)
Admin GraphQL: webhookSubscriptionCreate + bulkOperationRunQuery / bulkOperationRunMutation (integration and bulk sync)
Admin REST (legacy, resource-by-resource migrated to GraphQL-only): /admin/api/<version>/products.json, /orders.json, /customers.json *(verify per version)*
Shopify Functions targets: cart discounts, delivery/payment customization, cart transform, order routing, checkout/cart validation
Payments Apps API / Payments Platform (custom payment providers)
Partner/Billing and Bulk Data (bulk operations, Shopify Flow triggers and actions as integration surface)
target_content_component_types: section block (repeatable block configured inside a section)
app block (app-provided block placed into a theme section)
app embed block (theme app extension, global placement)
section group (header / footer / aside JSON groups)
metaobject definition + metaobject entry (structured, referenceable content)
metafield definition (product, variant, collection, customer, order, shop) incl. reference and file types
Online Store page / blog / article (flat editorial resources)
Dawn standard sections: rich text, image with text, slideshow, video, collapsible content, featured collection, featured product, multicolumn, newsletter, contact form
product media (image with focal point, video, external video, 3D model)
custom Liquid section / custom Liquid block (escape hatch)
Checkout UI extension block at a published checkout target (banner, field, custom block)
Hydrogen/React component (headless equivalent of a section - not interchangeable with Liquid)

_stamp.source: seed from general platform knowledge, to be verified
